}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "Mesh1800_Rev1.1" is silkscreened on board top. :OUI: B4:4B:D6:2E (''IEEE Registration Authority'') {{See also|Cudy|List of Wireless Systems}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[MediaTek]] MT7621AT :SoC: [[MIPS 1004Kc]] @880MHz *Flash: 32MB (SPI) flash ([[cFeon]]) *RAM: 256MB (DDR3L) SDRAM ([[Winbond]]) *Wi-Fi: [[MediaTek]] MT7905DAN/MT7975DN :802.11abgn/ac/ax 2T2R (AX1800) *Network: 2x 1GbE ports *Power Source: 12V/1.5A via barrel
